column1: # Original WritingDeck plots; MIT to the extent rights subsist; AI-assisted original drafting.
# stable_id|category|genres|premise

wd-p-0702|commitment|realist,romance|Two people agree to a trial separation while continuing a shared restoration project. The first finished room looks exactly like the home one hoped they would build together, and neither knows whether continuing is repair or postponement.

wd-p-0703|trust|realist,romance|A person asks a partner to stop offering solutions during difficult conversations. When a practical crisis arrives, the partner listens faithfully but withholds information that would help, forcing them to distinguish support from rigid obedience to a rule.

wd-p-0704|recognition|realist,romance|A couple attends a reunion where everyone remembers them as rivals. Their affectionate private account depends on leaving out the moment when one person gave up a competition the other still thinks was fairly won.

wd-p-0705|choice|realist,romance|A person receives an opportunity to live abroad just as a partner finally gains security at home. Each offers to move for the other, but both offers are made partly to avoid admitting a preference that might disappoint.

wd-p-0706|permission|realist,romance|Two neighbors begin sharing a rooftop garden and gradually treat it as a private refuge. A newcomer asks to use the communal space, exposing that their unspoken intimacy has depended on excluding someone with an equal right to be there.

wd-p-0707|attention|realist,romance|A person translates a partner's jokes for visiting friends and realizes the translations make the partner seem kinder than the originals. Explaining the difference would challenge both the jokes and the protective role the translator has assumed.

wd-p-0708|reciprocity|realist,romance|A couple agrees to divide costs according to income. When one changes careers for less money, the arrangement remains mathematically fair but makes every shared purchase feel like permission granted by the higher earner.

wd-p-0709|learning|realist,romance|A person learns a partner's favorite sport to share an interest. Becoming unexpectedly skilled threatens the partner's enjoyment of the one activity where they had not felt compared with anyone else.

wd-p-0710|identity|realist,romance|Two people meet through volunteering under shortened names. They later discover that their full names connect them to opposing sides of a local dispute neither wanted to bring into the friendship.

wd-p-0711|care|realist,romance|A partner organizes help after an illness and is praised for being indispensable. As recovery proceeds, the help becomes difficult to refuse because declining it seems to deny the care that held the relationship together.

wd-p-0712|commitment|speculative,romance|A service predicts the date when a couple will next fundamentally disagree. They schedule every major decision before that date, gradually discovering that avoiding disagreement has itself become their largest disagreement.

wd-p-0713|trust|realist,romance|A couple promises complete honesty during a weekend trip. One shares a minor doubt that the other treats as a final decision, and correcting the misunderstanding requires admitting that honesty includes thoughts not yet settled.

wd-p-0714|recognition|realist,romance|A person makes a playlist to explain feelings they struggle to say aloud. The recipient recognizes every song as one played at a previous relationship's ending and cannot hear the new meaning without discussing the old association.

wd-p-0715|choice|realist,romance|Two people win an opportunity intended for a single applicant after submitting a joint idea. Accepting together would require changing the award's rules, while accepting separately would turn their shared beginning into a claim of individual ownership.

wd-p-0716|permission|realist,romance|A couple offers each other unrestricted creative use of their shared life. A successful story portrays a truthful incident from only one viewpoint, and withdrawing permission now would affect work already promised to a publisher.

wd-p-0717|attention|realist,romance|One partner plans a perfect birthday using years of saved messages. The other discovers that an old wish has been honored after it ceased to fit, making the celebration a test of being remembered versus being known now.

wd-p-0718|reciprocity|realist,romance|A person accepts a partner's financial help as a temporary loan. The partner later calls it a gift during an argument, leaving them to decide whether generosity can change terms after it has shaped the recipient's choices.

wd-p-0719|learning|realist,romance|Two partners take a class together and are assigned to different groups. One flourishes outside the role of helping the other, while the other mistakes the new independence for a failure of their shared plan.

wd-p-0720|identity|speculative,romance|A traveler returns from a journey during which only a few days passed for her. Her partner has built a life over several years, and their reunion must accommodate promises both kept under incompatible understandings of waiting.

wd-p-0721|care|realist,romance|A person hides exhaustion to protect a partner facing a difficult deadline. The partner finishes early and plans an energetic celebration, interpreting the first honest refusal as indifference to the achievement.

wd-p-0722|commitment|realist,romance|A couple agrees to stay in their town until a parent recovers. Recovery becomes an uncertain long-term condition, and the promise that once felt precise now allows each partner to imagine a different end point.

wd-p-0723|trust|realist,romance|A person discovers that a partner rehearses difficult conversations with a friend. The rehearsals are respectful, but the friend knows decisions still being presented at home as open questions.

wd-p-0724|recognition|realist,romance|Two people restore an old photograph of their first trip. The missing edge shows an encounter one remembers as a turning point and the other has always considered a practical misunderstanding.

wd-p-0725|choice|realist,romance|A couple must select one witness for a small legal ceremony. Each chooses the friend who helped during their worst disagreement, revealing that those friends were given very different accounts of what happened.

wd-p-0726|permission|realist,romance|A partner asks to keep one room entirely private while moving in together. The room contains ordinary unfinished work, but the request challenges the other's belief that sharing a home means offering access to every part of a life.

wd-p-0727|attention|realist,romance|A person starts writing down small grievances to discuss them calmly later. A partner mistakes the list for evidence that affection is being audited, and the conversation must distinguish remembering harm from collecting a case against someone.

wd-p-0728|reciprocity|realist,romance|Two people exchange skills instead of paying each other for work. One task becomes much larger than expected, and renegotiating the exchange risks revealing how differently they value the other's expertise.

wd-p-0729|learning|realist,romance|A person asks a partner to teach a childhood game and learns that its familiar rules were invented by the partner's family. Playing with outsiders forces them to choose between preserving intimacy and admitting that fairness requires agreed rules.

wd-p-0730|identity|realist,romance|Two people begin dating while both are temporarily caring for someone else's pets. Their apparent compatibility depends on borrowed routines, and returning the animals reveals lifestyles neither has yet shown the other.

wd-p-0731|care|speculative,romance|A couple can share physical discomfort by holding matching stones. One secretly stops carrying a stone to spare the other, and the absence is discovered only when the other believes a treatment has begun to work.

wd-p-0732|commitment|realist,romance|A person agrees to move into a partner's family home for one year. Small renovations make the arrangement feel permanent to the family before the couple has decided whether the original limit still matters.

wd-p-0733|trust|realist,romance|A partner admits reading an unfinished letter that was never meant to be sent. The letter describes a feeling already changed, but proving that change would require treating a private draft as a statement that needs a defense.

wd-p-0734|recognition|realist,romance|A couple receives an anniversary portrait showing them in the roles friends expect them to occupy. One loves being recognized; the other sees a role they have been trying to leave, and the artist asks for permission to exhibit it.

wd-p-0735|choice|realist,romance|Two people planning a shared holiday independently choose the same destination for opposite reasons. One wants to revisit a meaningful place; the other wants to replace its old meaning with something new.

wd-p-0736|permission|realist,romance|A person gives a partner permission to share news of a difficult diagnosis with family. The partner tells a relative who responds helpfully but cannot keep confidence, turning an agreed disclosure into a public identity neither intended.

wd-p-0737|attention|realist,romance|A partner begins doing a disliked chore without being asked. The gesture gradually removes the other's only daily conversation with a neighbor, making practical help a surprising form of isolation.

wd-p-0738|reciprocity|realist,romance|A couple decides that each will plan one dream day for the other. Both days require the planner to perform an unfamiliar role, exposing expectations they have presented as simple preferences rather than requests for change.

wd-p-0739|learning|realist,romance|Two people practice giving and receiving criticism through a shared hobby. A harmless correction touches an old family rule about competence, and the person offering it must learn why an accurate observation is not neutral in every context.

wd-p-0740|identity|realist,romance|A person meets a partner's childhood friends and finds they use a nickname the partner dislikes. Challenging it would be supportive, but the partner has asked not to be defended in a way that revives the old embarrassment.

wd-p-0741|care|realist,romance|A partner takes over household communication during the other's grief. Months later, returning control means admitting that some relationships have grown closer to the helper and more distant from the person whose behalf they were acting on.

wd-p-0742|commitment|realist,romance|Two people agree to keep separate homes indefinitely. An emergency makes staying together temporarily necessary, and their friends celebrate a milestone neither has chosen, pressuring them to defend an arrangement that has been working.

wd-p-0743|trust|speculative,romance|A device can confirm whether someone intends to keep a promise at the moment it is made. A couple uses it for reassurance until one asks whether sincere intentions are enough to support plans requiring skills neither has yet learned.

wd-p-0744|recognition|realist,romance|A person finds that a partner's favorite story about their relationship combines details from several different days. Correcting it would remove an event the partner treasures, while leaving it intact would erase the less graceful beginning the other values.

wd-p-0745|choice|realist,romance|A couple receives an invitation that includes only one of them by name. The invited partner assumes the omission is administrative; the other knows the host has avoided acknowledging the relationship before.

wd-p-0746|permission|realist,romance|A person asks a partner to choose a new name for a shared business. The chosen name carries a private family association the partner does not know, and rejecting it would require revealing a history kept outside their work.

wd-p-0747|attention|realist,romance|One partner habitually remembers every preference except the other's wish not to be predicted. Planning a day with no advance decisions becomes unexpectedly difficult because even spontaneity has been carefully arranged.

wd-p-0748|reciprocity|realist,romance|A couple supports one person's creative year on the promise of reversing roles later. When the year ends, the second person no longer wants the same ambition, and the first struggles to offer support without insisting on repayment in the planned form.

wd-p-0749|learning|realist,romance|A person rehearses a partner's family customs to avoid mistakes at a gathering. The family has changed the custom after a disagreement, leaving the prepared gesture aligned with the side the partner hoped not to take.

wd-p-0750|identity|realist,romance|Two people who met while using pen names are invited to speak together publicly. One wants to reveal both identities as a shared celebration, while the other still needs the separation between creative work and ordinary employment.

wd-p-0751|care|realist,romance|A partner begins checking weather and travel conditions for the other's commute. Helpful warnings become a daily expectation, and the first missed message is interpreted as withdrawal rather than the limit of a voluntary act.

wd-p-0752|commitment|speculative,romance|A couple reserves a shared future appointment in a city where bookings cannot be canceled, only transferred. When their plans change, finding another pair willing to take the reservation becomes a conversation about what exactly they are giving away.

wd-p-0753|trust|realist,romance|A person discovers that a partner concealed a failed application to avoid disappointing them. The concealed failure would have been easy to share, but the invented success has already shaped a decision the couple cannot cheaply reverse.

wd-p-0754|recognition|realist,romance|A couple reads old messages to prepare a celebration of their relationship. One remembers the pauses as patient courtship, while the other was uncertain and relying on a friend's encouragement to continue replying.

wd-p-0755|choice|realist,romance|Two partners are each offered responsibility for the same community project. One sees working together as intimacy; the other wants a role where their achievements are not interpreted as an extension of the relationship.

wd-p-0756|permission|realist,romance|A person invites a partner to reorganize a shared kitchen. The new arrangement is efficient but removes the improvised system that let the first person cook despite a limitation they have never described directly.

wd-p-0757|attention|realist,romance|A partner secretly repairs every worn object the other uses. When an intentionally unfinished object is completed, the recipient must explain that not every imperfection was a problem waiting for someone else's care.

wd-p-0758|reciprocity|realist,romance|A couple tracks shared travel expenses precisely until one trip is extended to help a friend. Deciding which costs remain shared reveals whether their accounting follows consumption, intention, or the commitments they make together.

wd-p-0759|learning|realist,romance|Two people agree to communicate disagreement without sarcasm. The person who uses humor to make difficult feelings speakable becomes quiet, and the other must help build a new language rather than treating silence as improvement.

wd-p-0760|identity|realist,romance|A couple's friends assume one is adventurous and the other cautious. Planning a difficult move reveals the opposite, but both hesitate to abandon roles that have helped their friends understand and support them.

wd-p-0761|care|speculative,romance|A service lets a person send comfort to a partner at the time it will be most needed. The comfort arrives during a happy event, raising the possibility that the sender misunderstood what the event meant.

wd-p-0762|commitment|realist,romance|Two people promise to keep one evening a week for each other. When both become responsible for separate community obligations that meet on that evening, preserving the promise requires changing commitments other people reasonably rely on.

wd-p-0763|trust|realist,romance|A partner keeps an old emergency fund secret because it was once necessary for safety. Revealing it now would demonstrate trust but also surrender the privacy that makes trusting feel possible.

wd-p-0764|recognition|realist,romance|A person receives a loving description from a partner that praises how little help they need. Accepting the compliment would reinforce the very role that has made asking for help within the relationship difficult.

wd-p-0765|choice|realist,romance|A couple must decide whether to keep a difficult promise made during a crisis. One remembers it as a binding plan; the other remembers it as language used to make an unbearable night survivable.

wd-p-0766|permission|realist,romance|A person asks a partner to speak at a public celebration of a shared achievement. The partner can tell an honest story only by mentioning the private disagreement that made the achievement possible.

wd-p-0767|attention|realist,romance|Two partners exchange a daily photograph of something they notice. One begins choosing images for approval rather than observation, and a missed day exposes how the small ritual became another performance.

wd-p-0768|reciprocity|realist,romance|A partner offers to handle a difficult conversation with a landlord. Success improves the household's situation but leaves the other feeling excluded from a decision made using information they had asked to keep private.

wd-p-0769|learning|realist,romance|A couple joins a beginners' class to experience being equally inexperienced. One secretly practiced beforehand out of anxiety, and the revelation turns the shared exercise into a conversation about whether safety requires appearing competent.

wd-p-0770|identity|speculative,romance|A town's portrait artist paints people as those closest to them see them. A couple's portraits change dramatically after a minor disagreement, and they must decide whether to seek a repaint or learn what the changes reveal.

wd-p-0771|care|realist,romance|One partner plans a period of rest for the other and schedules every hour to remove decisions. The recipient's first wish is an unscheduled day, which the planner hears as rejection of the work invested in helping.

wd-p-0772|commitment|realist,romance|Two people agree not to make future plans while one faces an uncertain medical result. A time-sensitive housing offer arrives, and declining to decide is itself a choice that will shape where both can live.

wd-p-0773|trust|realist,romance|A partner admits that a treasured coincidence at their first meeting was deliberately arranged. The arrangement was harmless, but the other has relied on the story as proof that neither had to perform to be loved.

wd-p-0774|recognition|realist,romance|A person introduces a partner to a hometown under a carefully chosen itinerary. An accidental detour reveals an ordinary workplace left out of the story because the host feared that being fully known would change the visitor's affection.

wd-p-0775|choice|realist,romance|A couple is offered a shared studio smaller than their separate workspaces. Moving together would satisfy a long-held dream while making both abandon the practical conditions that currently let their work thrive.

wd-p-0776|permission|realist,romance|A person agrees to be the subject of a partner's creative project but not its spokesperson. When the project succeeds, an interview request blurs the boundary, and declining would leave the partner to explain why the subject is absent.
